verdict.rationale: Airwallex provides webhooks for event-driven automation, a full API/SDK/CLI stack, scoped API keys, and an explicit 'AgentOS' toolkit letting AI agents act autonomously on a production account (reading balances, issuing cards, creating beneficiaries), which supports background automation use cases. However there's no documented scheduler/cron-like trigger mechanism or explicit 'runs autonomously in background' workflow orchestration beyond webhook callbacks and agent-initiated actions. missing for 10: explicit scheduled/triggered automation workflows, independent/hands-on evidence of AgentOS running unattended in production.
